original_inspection.summary: Each Unicode scalar maps to 1–4 unsigned bytes; UTF-8 serialization preserves byte order. Lone surrogates are not valid UTF-8 text. Supports byte coverage reasoning, not meaningful generated text.

Byte-to-visible-character mapping includes each u8 exactly once. alphabet returns all mapping values. ByteLevel uses GPT2 regex pre-splitting, prepends a space only when add_prefix_space is true, converts all UTF-8 bytes to mapped characters, and decoder concatenates inverse bytes before from_utf8_lossy. Thus valid encode→decode text preserves unseen characters; arbitrary model ID strings can still decode with replacement characters.

Adds specials first; inserts initial alphabet regardless of corpus occurrence, sorted for deterministic IDs unless alphabet limiting applies; counts adjacent pairs within tokenized words; chooses highest pair counts and concatenates symbols; stops at target vocabulary, empty queue, or min frequency. Budget below initial alphabet can still produce a larger actual initial vocabulary. BPE fitting modifies vocabulary/merges, not a language model.
Encoding first obtains symbol IDs from saved vocabulary and calls word.merge_all with stored merges; it does not refit a language model.
